== Notes ==
*Evolved Warthogs deal [[slashing damage]], while unevolved Warthogs deal [[blunt damage]]. Unevolved warthogs are the only pets that deal blunt damage.
*[[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria/Elona)''

== Trivia == 
*There is a [[miniature]] version of the [[Miniature Pig|Warthog]].
*[[Librarian Kahlidahri]] in [[Holdings of Chokhin]] is "writing the definitive work on warthogs"
* Warthogs have two idle animations : 
** They may lower their head, as if about to charge.
** They may rise their head, as if picking up a scent in the air.
